10. The volume of gaseous products obtained by the thermal decomposition of
59.2 g of magnesium nitrate at STP is ______.
(a) 28 L (b) 22.4 L (c) 33.6 L (d) 54 L

11. The percentage composition of a compound is 80% C, 20% H. The weight
of $1.5 \times 10^{23}$ molecules of the compound is 7.5 g. Determine the molecular
formula of the compound.
(a) $\mathrm{C}_3\mathrm{H}_6$ (b) $\mathrm{C}_2\mathrm{H}_6$ (c) $\mathrm{C}_2\mathrm{H}_2$ (d) $\mathrm{C}_2\mathrm{H}_4$

12. In which among the following reactions is the mole ratio of reactants 1:3?
(a) Reaction of calcium with water.
(b) Reduction of ferric oxide with coke.
(c) Synthesis of sulphur trioxide.
(d) Reaction between sodium hydroxide and sulphuric acid.

13. 175 g of calcium carbonate on thermal decomposition gives 33.6 L $\mathrm{CO}_2$ at
STP. Calculate the percentage purity of calcium carbonate.
(a) 80.7% (b) 85.7% (c) 90.7% (d) 95.7%

14. 96 g of 'X' contains $9 \times 10^{23}$ molecules, and 0.32 g of gas 'Y' contains $1.2 \times 10^{22}$
molecules. Compare the rate of diffusion ($r$) of X and Y at the same temper-
ature and pressure.
(a) $r\mathrm{Y} = 3r\mathrm{X}$                                   (b) $r\mathrm{Y} = 2r\mathrm{X}$
(c) $r\mathrm{X} = 3r\mathrm{Y}$                                  (d) $r\mathrm{X} = 2r\mathrm{Y}$

15. 210 g of sodium bicarbonate is subjected to thermal decomposition in an
open vessel and in a container fitted with a condenser separately. Calculate
the change of loss in weight.
(a) 77.5 g (b) 22.5 g (c) 41 g (d) 55 g
